assistant_messages.content:
## Invoice approval flow

The flow diagram shows the process from receipt and three-way matching through approval, payment, and seven-year audit retention. Rejected invoices loop back to the supplier for correction; delayed budget-holder approvals are escalated to the Head of Finance. **[1][2][3][4]**

## Atlas vs. Borealis

The comparison shows that Borealis permits faster convenience termination—30 days versus Atlas’s 90 days—while Atlas has a more extensive set of liability-cap exclusions. Atlas expressly auto-renews annually, whereas Borealis is described as a fixed two-year agreement and does not state a renewal mechanism in the retrieved terms. **[5][10]**

## Atlas contract timeline

The timeline covers the Atlas agreement from signing on 14 March 2023 through service commencement, amendment, SLA issue, service credits, and the April 2026 price uplift. The key upcoming deadline is **15 December 2026** for non-renewal notice, followed by the current term end on **15 March 2027**; absent notice, the agreement renews for one year. **[9][11]**
